Olivia: PTAL — I pushed the commit that addresses the flaky e2e and the rebase. Tests are green locally and CI is passing except an intermittent docker pull timeout in staging.

Sam: Looking now. Did you change the e2e timeouts?

Olivia: Yep — increased timeout for the flaky setup step and added a short retry around the DB seed. Diff: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/842

Maria: Quick note: shared canary slots are full today. If this needs a canary run, we may need to schedule it for tomorrow morning.

Olivia: We can do a smoke-only canary (no perf) — should be fine. Command for smoke run: `./scripts/smoke_canary.sh --branch olivia/fix-e2e`

Sam: Ran the smoke script on my laptop, looks clean. CI flake is in docker hub — rerun should be fine. @build-bot can you request a rerun?

build-bot: Deploy request queued — CI re-run triggered for PR #842.

Sam: LGTM. One more approval from @Maria needed to schedule the canary slot.

Maria: Approving now. Ping me when the canary run is queued and I'll watch.

Olivia: Thanks! Queued at 1771112290, will watch output and follow up if any regressions. :tada:
